notes:
Lead origin: inbound from marketplace listing + developer signup.

Initial qualification: SMB sales-enablement app, 15 engineers + 20 SDR/AE users, building small assistant that ingests call transcripts and returns 3-bullet summaries + suggested talk tracks. Interested in hosted API for speed to market (self-serve).

Key asks on first call (2026-03-02):
- How long do you retain user audio/transcript by default? do you store raw transcripts or only embeddings?
- Can we turn off transcript retention and only keep ephemeral token-level cache?
- PII handling: need option to redact SSNs, emails, credit-card-like patterns before persistent storage. Quote from CTO: "we can’t expose sensitive customer PII to third-party storage — need a documented option to redact or opt-out".
- Cost sensitivity: ~250k tokens/month expected initially; wants per-token estimate and cost ceilings.
- Latency: live summarization target ~500-800ms median on short calls (<=120s). Can accept occasional tail >2s.
- Model preference: open to small LlaMA-family or mosaic-compat models; wants Redwood benchmark for 1s/turn.

Timeline and activity:
- 2026-03-02: Intro call (AE Samira) — demo of basic summary flow, captured follow-ups. (fireflies ff-91324)
- 2026-03-04: Sent sample curl/snippets + cost estimate stub (Samira). Gmail thread thread-gm-8921.
- 2026-03-05: Security questionnaire submitted — ticket RDW-1543 for retention detail.
- 2026-03-08: Engineering sync requested to discuss redaction options + webhook delivery guarantees. SE Leon to join.

Technical notes (engineer-to-engineer fragments):
- Prefer streaming responses to show partial bullets during live call.
- Want explicit TTL per resource and an API to purge conversation history per-user.
- Ask: does hosted API provide server-side regex redaction pipeline or do we need to pre-process client-side?
- Request sample policy docs: retention_control_options.md and hosted-api-dataflow.png (linked in drive).

Commercial / trial details:
- Self-serve evaluation: team will spin up dev keys and run 2-week POC.
- Would convert to paid once they can demonstrate redaction + consistent 1s median latency under dev traffic.

Next steps (short):
- Samira to share concise hosted-API implementation doc + explicit retention toggle examples (by 2026-03-11).
- Leon to run 30m technical Q&A (propose 2026-03-12) to discuss regex redaction vs server-side PII scrub, and provide sample purge API call.
- Provide a sample contract snippet describing data retention limits for SMB hosted plan.

Notes tone: choppy, action-oriented. Add follow-up items to RDW-1543 and attach sample drive doc.
company_notes_summary: SMB inbound from marketplace; wants hosted API. Primary concerns: PII retention/redaction and retention controls. Target: quick self-serve POC, then convert to paid if redaction+latency OK.
